name: quota-dashboard
description: PWA dashboard for AI provider usage and quotas

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && tsc -p tsconfig.server.json && tsc -p tsconfig.browser.json && tsc -p tsconfig.worker.json && mkdir -p dist/public dist/remote && cp public/index.html public/styles.css public/manifest.webmanifest public/icon.svg dist/public/ && cp remote/setup.sh dist/remote/setup.sh && cp package.json package-lock.json dist/ && node build-version.mjs
scripts.test: npm run build && node --test dist/lib/*.test.js dist/remote/*.test.js
